data.one_liner: A cross-platform Flutter camera plugin with native previews and RGB frame capture.
data.what_it_does: Allows capturing camera frames in RGB888 format and rendering native camera previews across Windows, Linux, macOS, iOS, Android, and web. It provides APIs to list devices, open cameras, start and stop previews, capture individual frames, and manage resolutions.
use_when: You need cross-platform camera preview and raw RGB888 frame capture.
You are building image processing or recognition SDK integrations such as barcode scanning.
avoid_when: You only need built-in high-level UI widgets for capturing photos or videos without accessing raw frame bytes.
strengths: Supports all major platforms including desktop, mobile, and web.
Provides zero-copy previews on native platforms.
Captures uncompressed RGB888 frames on demand without interrupting the preview stream.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific configuration and permissions for camera access.
Web platform requires HTTPS or localhost to function properly.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding camera permissions for macOS (Entitlements), iOS (Info.plist), and Android (AndroidManifest.xml). Web requires HTTPS or localhost.
